subject: Acceptance criteria, smoke test window and go-live fallback plan
message_1_subject: Re: MAP draft — locking acceptance gate and smoke test window
message_1_body:
Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the MAP draft. Acme is ready to lock a final go/no-go window but we need to confirm the acceptance criteria and have a 2-hour smoke test window during cutover (preferably 1–3am PT). Key asks from our side: a concise acceptance checklist we can sign off on, the runbook for the smoke test, and explicit rollback steps if traffic fails the checks.

Can you confirm the proposed launch date of Nov 4 and the owners for each acceptance item? We also need a DocuSign link for the final MAP sign-off by EOD Friday.

Thanks — Sandi
Sandi Lopez
Senior PM, Integrations
Acme Health
attachments: ACME_MAP_v3.pdf (draft)
message_2_subject: Re: MAP draft — locking acceptance gate and smoke test window
message_2_body:
Sandi — thanks, got it. Short answers and proposed plan below.

Launch date: tentative Nov 4 (target) — final when MAP signed.
Smoke test window: we can run the 1–3am PT window; recommend a dry run Nov 2 during business hours.
Acceptance checklist (high level):
- Latency P95 < 800ms for critical endpoints (owner: dev_patel)
- End-to-end correctness on 20 canonical prompts (owner: marissa_cole)
- No regressions vs baseline for critical flows (owner: ben_carter)
- Audit logs enabled and retention validated (owner: dev_patel)
- Rollback verified in staging and runbook exercised (owner: marissa_cole)

I attached an updated MAP (ACME_MAP_v3.pdf) with these items mapped to owners and target SLAs. Ben, Marissa, Dev — please confirm owners/timelines below and add any gaps.

Action requested from Acme: sign DocuSign by EOD Fri to hold Nov 4 slot; confirm if 1–3am PT works.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
message_3_subject: Re: MAP draft — owner confirmations and integration checklist
message_3_body:
Confirming owners and adding operational tasks. Short list: 

1) Integration smoke items (owner: ben_carter) — due Nov 1
   - Canary traffic config for 5% / 25% / 100% steps (traffic_split_plan.xlsx attached)
   - End-to-end verification with API keys from Acme test org

2) Data retention & audit (owner: dev_patel) — due Oct 28
   - Ensure audit logs for request/response persisted for 90 days
   - Verify KMS key usage for customer workspace

3) Eval plan (owner: marissa_cole) — due Oct 30
   - Run canonical prompt set against candidate model and baseline
   - Acceptance is zero critical failures and <=2 minor deviations out of 20 prompts

4) Rollback run (owner: marissa_cole) — dry run Nov 2
   - Validate toggle to prior model + traffic shift back to baseline

I will own the canary ramp plan in prod. We'll provide the traffic schedule by EOD tomorrow.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
message_4_subject: Re: MAP draft — runbook outline and rollback checklist
message_4_body:
Adding runbook/run-through specifics and on-call coverage. See attached runbook_smoke_v1.md for full steps; excerpt below: 

Runbook excerpt (smoke test):
- Pre-cutover checks (T-2h): infra health, kv-cache priming, baseline eval results verified (owners: dev_patel, marissa_cole)
- Cutover start (T-0): enable canary 5% for 30m, validate logs and correctness, escalate on any critical failures
- Ramp (T+30m): move to 25% for 45m, then evaluate
- Full (T+2h): 100% if pass, otherwise initiate rollback checklist

Rollback checklist (if any critical failure):
1) Freeze incoming change sets (DevOps)
2) Trigger model toggle to baseline variant (DevOps + Marissa)
3) Shift traffic back to baseline per traffic_split_plan.xlsx schedule (Ben)
4) Notify Acme and open postmortem channel

On-call: Marissa (primary), Dev (secondary) for the smoke window. I'll be on standby Nov 4 00:30–04:00 PT.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Launch Lead — Redwood Inference
